column1: # DSP48E2 config bits measured by black-box fuzzing (xcku3p-ffva676-1-e)
# PROVENANCE: see the "Vivado black-box fuzz" section of PROVENANCE.md.
# Method: one attribute changed per bitstream from a base design, bitstream
# diffed against the base. Same black-box method prjxray/prjuray used for
# their CC0 databases. Raw .bit/.ll/.dcp files are NOT in this repo.
# Target: DSP48E2_X0Y44 at tile DSP_X3Y110 (column 68, row 134, X0Y1).
# Frame base minor 4; the DSP occupies minors 4..6 of FAR 0x00040e04..e06.
# Bit numbers below are absolute within a frame (0..2591).
#   +8   the diff set the bit (base had 0)
#   -8   the diff cleared the bit (base had 1)
# POLARITY WARNING: "-8" rows mean the stored bit is the INVERSE of the
# attribute value: to emit value "to", CLEAR the bit. Rows marked +8 set it.
# An attribute with several rows must have them applied together; that is the
# whole point of the multi-row AMULTSEL/BMULTSEL entries below.
# Every row here was independently re-derived from the base and variant
# .bit.gz pairs and matched the stored per-variant diff exactly
# (49 of 49 variants, 0 mismatches, ECC words 45/46 excluded).
# NOT MEASURED (still blocked): any pipeline register value other than the
# base (all registers = 1) or the MREG 1->0 row below; USE_SIMD TWO24/FOUR12
# (Vivado refused both, dsp_v009/v010 BIT_FAIL); IS_*_INVERTED on a driven
# pin (Vivado accepted the change but wrote no bit: dsp_v023/v024/v026-v037);
# MASK and SEL_MASK changes (no bit written: dsp_v016/v018/v019/v020);
